newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,355 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,355 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,355 contracts compared with 886 overnight Wednesday.
There were 153 wheat, 453 corn, 630 soybean, 10 soymeal, 38 soyoil, two wheat calls, five corn calls and 64 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one cent higher to two cents lower, corn was 1/4 to 1-1/4 cents higher and soybeans were 1/2 cent lower to 3-3/4 cents higher.
